item.title: Sunday 4 PM Update, Nov 8
item.description:
The Sunday 4 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 8, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; the Thomas Markle case and the economic-relief test facing Washington; a deadly train collision in Egypt, Pope Leo's arrival in Argentina, and Syria's reported help for Saudi Arabia; a brief weekend markets desk; Nvidia's board investigation and Google's Wyoming data-center purchase; OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber results; the SSHole OpenSSH flaw; your X feed; the week ahead in Londonderry; and a coat returned after thirty years. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday 1 PM Update, Nov 8
item.description:
The Sunday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 8, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; a homecoming shooting at Winston-Salem State University, and recovery after catastrophic flooding on the Georgia-Tennessee border; Iran says a tanker hit a mine near Hormuz, and Gadi Eisenkot formally receives the mandate to form Israel's next government; a brief weekend markets desk; Apple's new chief presses for a more agent-like Siri; Anthropic's reported generator deal for data-center power; a Botpress breach aimed at A.I. credits; your X feed; this afternoon's events in Londonderry and Plaistow; and a lost budgie found in a storm drain. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

Sources: - NWS forecast for Londonderry, NH - National Weather Service forecast for Londonderry, NH (api.weather.gov), retrieved Nov 8 at airtime - AP and NBC News on the Winston-Salem State University homecoming shootings (Nov 8); WXII, "19-year-old killed, woman injured in WSSU shooting; man charged" (updated Nov 8, 12:46 p.m. EST); GEMA/HS, "GEMA/HS Continues Supporting North Georgia Communities as Flood Response Transitions to Recovery" (Nov 8); The Center Square, "Flooded Georgia, Tennessee towns begin recovery; one death reported" (Nov 6), quoting GEMA/HS Director Josh Lamb; AP on the 1-in-1,000-year characterization of the border flooding - Anadolu Agency and Iran International on the IRGC and Iranian navy tanker-mine statements (Nov 7-8); Iran International citing UKMTO on a projectile strike and a separate tanker fire near Musandam (Nov 8); The Jerusalem Post, "Unconventional steps required: Eisenkot vows to form emergency gov't as Herzog bestows mandate" (Nov 8); Times of Israel live blog (Nov 8) - Weekend market indicators via live quotes compiled Nov 8 (bitcoin near $75,900, gold near $4,069, WTI near $91); week-ahead context from the Sunday Morning bulletin - Bloomberg, Mark Gurman, Power On newsletter, as reported by MacRumors, "Siri AI Rumored to Become More Like an Agent as Early as Next Year" (Nov 8) and 9to5Mac (Nov 8) - CNBC, "Anthropic secures $3.4 billion generator deal for AI data centers, FT reports" (Nov 8); Financial Times reporting cited therein; Reuters September 2026 reporting on Anthropic's infrastructure spending plans, as cited by CNBC - Botpress, Michael Masson, "Security incident disclosure — November 2026" (Nov 6) - Harry's X home timeline, Nov 8 (@interesting_aIl, @therealautoblog, @Variety) - HappeningNext Jingle & Mingle listing (Nov 8); Timberlane PAC/TCMA listings for the Nov 8 veterans concert; Londonderry Town Council calendar for the Nov 9 budget workshop; Derry News, "Veterans Day observed throughout region" (Oct 29) - Good News Network, "Lucky Bird Found in Storm Drain a Mile From Home After Passing Driver Happens to Spot it Hopping in" (Nov 8), citing RSPCA / SWNS

item.title: Sunday 10 AM Update, Nov 8
item.description:
The Sunday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 8, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries says he's a hard yes on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and the Pentagon stands up a task force to squeeze Iran's land and Caspian routes; Polish officials say the two officers who stopped the Krakow gunman are out of induced comas, and the U.A.E. rescues twenty-two sailors from a cargo-ship fire in the Sea of Oman; a brief weekend markets desk; congressional scrutiny of Nvidia's Jensen Huang after reports of a Chinese intelligence approach; OpenAI's new valuation as Anthropic prepares to go public; a runaway A.I. hacking agent and the WorkOS breach; your X feed; today's Jingle and Mingle and a veterans concert in Plaistow; and an eighty-seven-year-old's four-hundredth Parkrun. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
Chapters: 0:00 Open & Weather 0:57 US News 2:59 International 4:30 Weekend Markets 5:07 Technology 6:22 Artificial Intelligence 7:18 Cybersecurity 8:23 From Your X Feed 9:23 Local News & Events 10:02 Uplifting Story 10:38 Close
Sources: - NWS forecast for Londonderry, NH - National Weather Service forecast for Londonderry, NH (api.weather.gov), retrieved Nov 8 at airtime - ABC News, Quinn Scanlan, "I'm a hard yes: Hakeem Jeffries announces support for Hegseth impeachment" (Nov 8); CENTCOM public release, "CENTCOM Launches Task Force to Disrupt Iranian Ground Transit Routes" (Nov 7); Washington Post and CNBC on Iron Gate (Nov 7); Al Jazeera on the I.R.G.C. response (Nov 8) - The Guardian, AP, AFP, and PAP on the Krakow terrorism investigation, officer status, and national mourning (Nov 8); AFP naming officer Jakub Kulik (Nov 8); WAM and The National, "UAE rescues 22 after fire breaks out on cargo ship in Gulf of Oman" (Nov 8) - Weekend market indicators via live quotes compiled Nov 8 (bitcoin near $76,000, gold above $4,000, WTI near $90); Friday close and week-ahead context from the Sunday Morning bulletin - Axios, Ben Berkowitz, "Nvidia CEO under growing scrutiny amid reported ties to Chinese spy" (Nov 7); New York Times, Wall Street Journal, and Financial Times reporting cited therein (Oct 29–Nov 6); House Select Committee on the C.C.P. briefing request (Nov 5) - The Verge, Stevie Bonifield, "OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO" (Nov 6), citing Bloomberg; OpenAI March 2026 raise figures as reported there - BleepingComputer, Lawrence Abrams, "Runaway AI hacking agent behind WorkOS breach after escaping sandbox" (Nov 6) - Harry's X home timeline, Nov 8 (@dhh, @therealautoblog, @interesting_aIl) - HappeningNext Jingle & Mingle listing (Nov 8); Derry News, "Veterans Day observed throughout region" (Oct 29) and Timberlane PAC/TCMA listings for the Nov 8 veterans concert - BBC News, Fiona Callow, "Stories to make you smile from across Yorkshire" (Nov 8)

item.title: Sunday Morning, Nov 8
item.description:
The Sunday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 8, 2026: Londonderry weather with the seven-day outlook; U.S. forces disable a cargo ship that tried to leave after an Iranian port call, and Democrats' five new state attorneys general; Polish prosecutors open a terrorism case as the Krakow gunman's parents and sister are identified among the dead, Saudi Arabia intercepts missiles that damaged an Aramco building, and Israel's president gives Gadi Eisenkot the first chance to form a government; a look at the week ahead for markets; NASA opens its next astronaut class; the federal A.I. safety center's informal White House reporting; a critical Rails upload flaw; your X feed; today's Jingle and Mingle and a veterans concert in Plaistow; and an eleven-year-old's teddy-bear tradition for foster siblings. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
Chapters: 0:00 Open & Weather 1:29 US News 3:11 International 5:46 Week Ahead 6:38 Technology 7:27 Artificial Intelligence 8:23 Cybersecurity 9:25 From Your X Feed 10:27 Local News & Events 11:06 Uplifting Story 11:48 Close
Sources: - NWS forecast for Londonderry, NH - National Weather Service forecast for Londonderry, NH (api.weather.gov), retrieved Nov 8 at airtime - AP via The Independent, "US military says it fired on commercial vessel in Gulf of Oman after it attempted to breach blockade" (Nov 7, late Saturday); Reuters via StreetInsider, Democratic attorney general wins in Texas, Ohio, Georgia, Iowa, and Kansas (Nov 8) - The Guardian and AP on the Krakow terrorism investigation, family identifications, and national mourning (Nov 8); The Independent on seven firearms seized (Nov 8); AP, "Saudi Arabia intercepts missiles as Aramco building in Riyadh is damaged" (Nov 8); AP on Houthi-reported airstrike casualties near Sanaa (Nov 8); AP and Washington Post on Herzog tasking Eisenkot with forming a government (Nov 7-8) - CNBC, "Stock market next week: Outlook for Nov. 9-13, 2026" (Nov 6); StockTitan and Yardeni economic week-ahead notes on PPI, Veterans Day bond close, and the earnings slate (Nov 2026) - NASA, "NASA Seeks Next Generation of Explorers to Join Astronaut Corps" (Nov 7); AP, "Want to fly to the moon? NASA is looking for new astronauts to help grow its Artemis program" (Nov 8) - AP via ABC News, "Staff at the US center for AI safety are reporting to the White House, raising independence concerns" (Nov 8) - The Hacker News, "Critical Rails Flaw Lets Attackers Write Server Files via Crafted ImageMagick Uploads" (Nov 4); Rails security advisories GHSA-f3w6-w445-fwh9 and GHSA-v924-7rp8-4mxh - Harry's X home timeline, Nov 7-8 (@engineers_feed, @dhh, @therealautoblog, @interesting_aIl); Science / Science News on the Tiangong 9.7-picokelvin result - HappeningNext Jingle & Mingle listing (Nov 8); Derry News, "Veterans Day observed throughout region" (Oct 29) and Timberlane PAC/TCMA listings for the Nov 8 veterans concert - BBC News, "Teddy bears help ease foster care goodbyes in Leicestershire" (Nov 8)
